components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact high-commitment action with a visible keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-bold, #5b2a9e); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--accent-bold, #5b2a9e); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); padding: 8px 16px; font: 700 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #4a2180); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #4a2180); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-active, #35145f); border-color: var(--accent-active, #35145f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-focus, #7c3aed); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action that remains quiet until hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-text, #111); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d8d8); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); padding: 8px 16px; font: 700 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent-border, #7c3aed); color: var(--accent-default, #5b2a9e); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-focus, #7c3aed); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Capability Card
components.description: Interactive evidence record with restrained elevation and clear metadata hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-capability-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 16px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-text, #111); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-soft, #e7e7e7); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04), 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.03); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-capability-card strong { font-size: 1rem; } .ds-capability-card > span:not(.ds-card-tag) { color: var(--color-text-muted, #5a5a5a); } .ds-capability-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent, #5b2a9e); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.05), 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.06); } .ds-capability-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-focus, #7c3aed); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-tag { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e5eefb; color: #1a4a8a; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Inset Label Field
components.description: Creation-flow field with a persistent inset label and large touch target.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: block; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-field span { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 16px; z-index: 1; color: var(--color-text, #111); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; pointer-events: none; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 76px; padding: 34px 16px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d8d8); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-text, #111); font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-focus, #7c3aed); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Positive Status Chip
components.description: Semantic state label whose color is reserved for positive status data.
components.css: .ds-chip-positive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--tone-positive-bg, #e3f3e8); color: var(--tone-positive-text, #146c2e); font: 700 .75rem/1.33 var(--font-body, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 76px; padding: 18px 10px; background: var(--sidebar-bg, #151515); } .ds-rail-item { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--sidebar-text-muted, #a6a6a6); cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: #fff; } .ds-rail-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-active-bg, #2a2a2a); color: var(--accent-subtle, #f1e9ff); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This system is a calm, rigorous, accountable workspace for inspecting capability evidence and making portfolio decisions. Its compact dark rail acts as a stable tool rack beside an off-white working plane; white records, tables, and drawers hold the evidence without competing with it.

The visual language is deliberately operational rather than promotional. Dense information is made navigable through strong type hierarchy, consistent spacing, quiet borders, explicit semantic states, and selective depth. Interaction color is scarce and meaningful, while status color always preserves its data meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Compact monochrome application chassis with a dark icon rail.
Off-white workspace and white evidence surfaces.
Backpack-derived typography with strong, compact headings.
Evidence Violet reserved for interaction, focus, and illustrative evidence.
Semantic status colors that never become decoration.
Right-docked drawers for detail and creation work.

rules.name: The One Interaction Voice Rule
rules.body: Evidence Violet is the only chromatic interaction accent; do not introduce competing section or navigation colors.

rules.name: The Status Is Data Rule
rules.body: Positive, caution, information, negative, and neutral colors communicate state only. Never reuse them for decorative card edges, page sections, or generic emphasis.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Skyscanner Relative across display, body, labels, tables, and controls; hierarchy comes from role, weight, size, and spacing rather than decorative type changes.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: Depth must indicate containment, interaction, or transience; static page sections do not receive shadows merely for decoration.

dos: Do preserve the dark-rail, off-white-workspace, white-surface hierarchy.
Do use semantic tone pairs consistently and keep unknown states explicitly labelled.
Do let borders, spacing, and typography carry most of the hierarchy.
Do keep evidence tables horizontally scrollable when their information model requires width.
Do use right-docked drawers for contextual detail and creation work.
donts: Don't use decorative gradients or mixed accents within a section.
Don't repurpose semantic status colors as navigation, card-edge, or section decoration.
Don't introduce editorial serif typography into the application system.
Don't import public marketing graphics or illustrated empty states into this evidence workspace.
Don't imply that visual polish makes illustrative or unknown data confirmed.
